title: Strip poker, cotch and other card games; a house move
summary: Punch explains how loose deuces and cotch work; he mentions an upcoming move.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: What's strip poker like? How do you play that?

Well they call it loose deuces. But it's strip poker, like they deal you five cards, and you got three aces, and maybe you got a seven or eight, where you put your three aces down and throw them in. And everybody, what they don't, card they don't like to throw them in, well they give you two more cards. But on them three aces, if you catch another ace, you got a great big hand. You sure have. Four aces, see. And if you catch two kings, well that's a full house, you see. Three aces and two kings.
Well they call that draw poker, right? Yeah. Same thing as draw poker.
Yeah, same thing as draw poker.
Now what is cotch anyway?
Cots, well I'll have to sit down and show you that. That's a peculiar game. You take the tens out of the deck.
Clean out.

But you use two decks. See, the little end of the deck, the ace is the one, deuce is two, three is the three, four is the four, five, five, six, six, well that's the deck. Right there. You dig in, the seven is the ace, the eight is the deuce, the nine is the three, the jack is the four, the queen is the five, the king is the six. And then you deal from the bottom of the deck. You don't deal from the top, deal from the bottom. And men can play with a little small deck like that. But the reason of it, so many men are going to get out, you know, pass out all the time because they ain't got no kind of card. You catch a deuce or something like that, you ain't got nothing there, you see, so you just throw that in. Men get a five spot and a six spot, and a man may bet on a four.
Does it work like poker? Is it similar to poker at all?
Well, it's on the order of poker, yeah, but it's not different.
Well if you had four deuces, would that be good in cotch? In cotch?
In cotch?
No. What do you got to have to win in cotch?

Well, they go by numbers. If you got six of hearts, and five of hearts, that's eleven. That's a big hand. Then if you catch the four of hearts, or the three of hearts, or the deuce of hearts, or any other kind of hearts, you got cotch. That's called cotch, that's the name of the game, cotch. If you catch three sixes, that's the biggest cotch in the deck, three sixes.

We'll have to get a deck of cotch, a couple of decks, and we'll cotch. We'll come back and play sometime. Yeah. You can show me how these different games work. Yeah. Tunk is another one I want to play.
You don't know Tunk even?
I never have played Tunk, man. I wish I had a deck of cotch.
Or Coom Can, I've never played Coom Can. Yeah, Dick get a deck, yeah?
Yeah, we'll get us some decks, and we'll learn how to play those games, because I think all that, people ought to know that, you know?

Yeah, and something else I'd like for you to know right now, Dick, of course this ain't supposed to be on here, but I can say so. We got to move right after the first of the month. They're going to repair that house. Yeah. And I think, of course I'll let you know where it is, but I think we're going to be down on Second Street there somewhere, but I'll have to let you know later.
You'll be near Carrie Boots. Huh? Right near Carrie Boots.
Somewhere in New York, yeah, we're closer than we are now.
